## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Graz, Austria. It starts at Herrengasse 16.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get fired up for a close-up weapons inspection of over 32,000 real guns, spears, swords, artillery, and shiny suits of armor at Landeszeughaus, the world's biggest historical armory. Learn fascinating facts on each grim death-bringing implement, and the history of Styria's war-torn past with military precision.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €12.70. It was rated 4.2 out of 5 from 15 ratings and 9 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
